about_the_game:
WELCOME LORRAINE

Age: 36 years old

Zodiac Sign: Leo

Preferences: Sex in luxury cars and yachts, orgies, developing her own sex toys.

Lorraine is as cold as she is calculated, a master of pragmatism. The feelings of others barely register on her radar, and she carries herself with an air of superiority that reflects her deep pride in her aristocratic bloodline. She chooses her sexual partners carefully, especially when it comes to sex orgies in her home.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

From now on, Lorraine will become not only your reliable companion but your refined muse! Lorraine will always keep you company on the main screen with her elegant animations and sharp dialogues.

By purchasing this DLC, you get the Lorraine mascot! You can switch your mascot at any time by opening your profile and choosing the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you're getting 5000 credits and 150 super serum.

But most importantly, you're getting our undying gratitude! Thank you for considering purchasing this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
